title: Forces cgroupfs on WSL to fix the regression with WSL v3
body:
<!-- Thanks for sending a pull request! -->

Fixes #29749

It's the same fix as podman-container-tools/podman-machine-os#319, but
this PR fixes existing machines too, the ones that have been created with an
older podman-machine-os image.

The podman-machine-os PR still makes sense for users who are creating a
new podman machines with a podman client with version <= v6.1.3.
